changelog:
- Skill renamed to rollinggo-searchhotel and homepage updated.
- Switched API key environment variable to ROLLINGGO_API_KEY and made API key pre-check mandatory; users now receive a prompt to configure the key before any CLI call.
- Added explicit version freshness instructions: always use the latest release on each execution.
- Added reference to new persistent environment variable docs (references/claw-host-env.md).
- Dropped previous skill card documentation file.
- Minor metadata and descriptive updates for clarity and branding.
summary: 使用 RollingGo CLI 查询酒店信息、筛选结果、读取酒店标签和获取房型价格。当用户需要按目的地 / 日期 / 星级 / 预算 / 标签 / 距离搜索酒店、查看酒店详情与房型报价，或读取酒店标签库时触发本技能。触发短语——"搜索酒店"、"查酒店"、"酒店详情"、"房型价格"、"酒店标签"、"附近酒店"、"rollinggo"。
